column3: A large round fish faces right with a wide open angular mouth, small eye and curved gill. A much smaller fish swims directly ahead of its mouth.

A broad cereal bowl appears in perspective with an oval opening and a rounded underside. A few short marks sit inside its otherwise plain visible surface.

column2: Open Gender Symbol with Small Shapes
column3: An open circular form ends in an arrow pointing upper right. Two detached circles and a triangle cluster near its lower left opening, with no clear connection between them.

A long broom bends from its narrow rounded handle into a broad two tipped sweeping head. A small rounded dust cloud floats to the left of the curved body.
A tapered bubble tea cup has a domed lid crossed by a horizontal rim. A bent straw rises from the top, and three circular pearls sit inside the cup.
A brass bugle has a narrow horizontal mouthpiece leading into a broad flared bell at the right. Its lower tubing curves back into a large open oval loop.
A tall rectangular building with three pairs of small windows stands within a much larger flame. The flame rises behind its roof and curls upward along both sides.
A tall central skyscraper rises above stepped side towers of decreasing height. Several short horizontal facade marks punctuate the main shaft beneath a narrow top section and spire.
A banknote tilts toward the upper right with a circular center mark and an open lower edge. A large flame overlaps its lower left corner, enclosing a smaller flame.
A rounded bowl holds a spoon whose handle leans upward to the right. The spoon head dips below the oval rim, beside a curved line marking the contents.
A hen stands facing right with a pointed beak, rounded crest and small wattle. Its broad curved body rises into a short tail above two thin feet.
Three adjoining buildings increase in height from left to right, combining flat and pitched roofs. Short paired window marks punctuate their fronts beneath a small cloud at upper left.
A tall drinking cup tapers toward a rounded base beneath an open flat rim. A bent straw projects upward, and an uneven liquid line crosses the cup's middle.
A bulldozer faces right with a raised angular cab above a long rounded track. A short horizontal arm connects the body to a tall curved blade at the front.
A worker faces forward beneath a domed safety helmet with a raised central ridge and wide brim. A plain oval face sits above broad shoulders and an open collar.
A broad sausage curves upward at both ends, forming a shallow crescent. Rounded caps and small forked ties mark its tips, while the long central casing remains plain.
An upright oval brooch surrounds a smaller oval center. A straight pin extends horizontally from its right edge to a separate round fastening, leaving the ornamental face plain.
A double decker bus appears in side view with two rows of divided windows. A rounded roof tops its tall body, and two circular wheels project below the lower edge.
A tall bus faces forward with rounded upper corners and a narrow horizontal window near its roof. A lower front seam and paired lights sit above two short wheels.
Four smooth wave lines flow horizontally at different heights. The middle curves meet briefly near the right side, creating an overlapping rhythm of broad crests and shallow troughs.
A circular sewing button has a wide outer rim surrounding four small holes. Two diagonal threads cross between opposite holes, forming an X at the center.
A fried egg with a round yolk sits beside a wavy strip of bacon. Above them lies a rounded sausage marked with three short diagonal scoring lines.

A broom angles upward to the right from a wide curved head. Its rounded handle joins a domed collar above long bristles that flare outward toward the sweeping edge.
A brain appears from above as two matching lobed halves divided by a straight central seam. A few short curved folds mark the rounded surface on each side.
A slice of bread has a broad rounded top and a narrower flat base. A knife crosses it diagonally over a curved patch of spread near the center.
A tall bottle with rounded shoulders and a narrow capped neck stands beside a small glass. A horizontal line divides the glass, indicating its partially filled interior.
A horizontal capsule-shaped roll has a rounded right end and a curved seam near its left end. A diagonal line crosses that end section, leaving the main body plain.
A megaphone points right with a wide flared horn and thick rounded front rim. A compact rear housing carries a downward handle, while a small dome projects beyond the bell.
A pair of briefs faces forward beneath a broad waistband. Curved seams descend toward a narrow central crotch, framed by two high rounded leg openings at the sides.
A tapered milkshake cup holds a high swirl of whipped cream above its flat rim. A bent straw rises at the right, and a wavy liquid line crosses the cup.
Two narrow towers stand side by side with rooflines sloping in opposite directions. Short horizontal window bands and small ground level doors mark each building, with a mast on the taller one.
A paper boat has an angular hull with raised pointed ends and a triangular center peak. Diagonal fold lines meet in the middle and extend toward its flat lower corners.
A rounded square sits above and to the left of a larger circle. Their complete outlines overlap across the square's lower right corner, leaving both interiors empty.
A small sailboat has a trapezoidal hull and one triangular sail rising above its center. Two rows of waves run below, with a rounded cloud in the upper right sky.
A rectangular office building with four square windows is interrupted at its lower right by a person bust. The circular head and rounded shoulders occupy the cleared corner.
A person stands to the right of a snowman formed from two stacked circles. One arm extends toward the snowman, whose left side carries a short angled stick arm.
A broad rounded rectangular buckle encloses a smaller opening with a short inward prong. Matching belt ends emerge at the left and right sides of the frame.
A broad semicircular hump rises from a straight horizontal baseline. Short upright sides join the smooth domed top to the ground, with no interior markings or surrounding objects.
A large circular outline is interrupted across its middle by a continuous undulating band. The band rises into a tall narrow central peak, then dips toward both sides.
A beetle has a rounded head above an oval body split by a vertical seam. Two curved antennae rise above it, and six straight legs extend from the sides.

A vulture stands facing right with a large hooked beak and curved neck. A long pointed wing covers its body, ending above an angular tail and thin supporting leg.
A suspension bridge spans water on two tall supports. Curved cables descend from the tower tops toward the deck, while two rows of scalloped waves run beneath it.
Two pointed tea leaves spread from a curved branching stem at upper left. Five rounded pearls overlap in a compact cluster below and to the right of the leaves.
Three broad grains form a triangular group with one above and two below. Each has a pointed upper tip, curved sides and a flattened rounded base.
Three upright eggs sit side by side within a shallow bowl-shaped nest. Their pointed tops rise above the curved rim, while their lower portions are hidden inside.
A straight vertical stem branches diagonally to the left and right at different heights. Three circular nodes cap the central stem and the two slanted branches.

A tulip bloom has three rounded pointed petals overlapping above a straight stalk. Two broad leaves extend outward near its base, with the right leaf sitting slightly lower.
Two upright grain stalks stand at different heights with pointed leaves alternating along their stems. Curved pairs near the tops spread outward and overlap across the gap between the stalks.
A uniformed person faces forward beneath a broad peaked cap and curved visor. The plain head sits above a short neck and rounded shoulders divided by a central shirt seam.
A continuous U-shaped curve rises into two upward pointing arrowheads at different heights. The right stem extends much higher than the left, above a broad rounded lower bend.
A rounded rectangular vessel contains a wavy horizontal line near its upper third. The line reaches both sides, dividing a shallow empty upper area from a larger lower interior.
A brassiere has two deep teardrop shaped cups joined by a short central bridge. Thin vertical shoulder straps rise from the outer tops, framing the open space between them.
A thick C-shaped clamp opens to the left around a straight vertical screw. A short pressure bar sits inside the opening, and a wider rounded handle crosses the screw below.
A narrow vertical cable tie has a broad rounded square locking head at the top. A small slot marks the head, and horizontal divisions cross the straight strap below.
A car faces forward with a broad windshield above a rounded body and two short wheels. Seven small circular wash bubbles form two staggered rows overhead.
A shallow semicircular sifter hangs beneath a straight horizontal rim that extends right as a handle. Two rows of short falling marks descend below its rounded base.
A rounded baseball cap has a top button and small semicircular rear opening. Beneath it sit two broad rounded sunglass lenses joined by a short bridge.
A rectangular cake with rounded corners carries a wavy icing line across its upper half. One thin candle rises from the center, topped by a teardrop flame.
A rounded rectangular cake has scalloped icing hanging across its front. Three upright candles and separate teardrop flames rise above it, while a straight serving line rests below.
A compact car faces right with a small side window and two round wheels. Its hood lifts above the front, with two wavering steam strokes rising from the engine area.
A circular target contains two inner rings and an arrow embedded near its center. The long shaft extends diagonally toward upper right, ending in an angular feathered tail.
A rounded camera body has a raised top housing and a central circular lens. A separate wavy vertical line on each side suggests the camera trembling laterally.
A tall pine tree stands to the left of a triangular tent on a shared baseline. The tree has stepped branches, while a smaller triangle marks the tent entrance.
A triangular tent sits beside a tall tree with an oval crown and branching trunk. Both rest on a straight ground line, and a small triangle marks the tent opening.
A rectangular battery has rounded corners and two short terminals projecting from its top. A minus mark sits beneath the left terminal and a plus beneath the right.

A car tilts along a steep ramp rising toward the right. Its rounded body and two wheels sit parallel to the slope above the triangular solid profile of the ramp.
A front facing car hovers above two open cupped hands. Its broad windshield, side mirrors and small wheels sit symmetrically between the raised fingertips of the hands.
